label: Compact operation (Sync Gateway)
type: the REST-triggered operation (POST /{db}/_compact) purging the JSON bodies of non-leaf revisions and removing purged tombstones from the channel cache. Referred to independently, in different vocabulary, by three pages in this batch: as an operation (this concept), a timing statistic (compaction_tombstone_start_time), and a background 'task' name in a Prometheus metric - none of the three cross-reference each other.
note: See sgw:tombstone for the headline cross-product finding this operation feeds into.
